notes.title: M&B Update
notes.notes: Music & Background changes according to progression

notes.title: Ulti Update
notes.notes: Get an ultimate attack after getting your health to full playing mini games!

notes.title: Minor Changes
notes.notes: Movement & Max Health limitations, attack projectile changes & bug fixes

notes.title: New Mini Game & Bug Fixes
notes.notes: New mini game is added. Some bug fixes, ui changes & movement system changes

notes.title: Slow-Mo Update
notes.notes: When you stop, time slows down, try it when you feel vulnerable <3

notes.title: Visual Changes & Minor Fixes
notes.notes: Poison cloud visual changes, flying enemies now drop poisonous clouds when they die. Minor animation fixes.

notes.title: Power-Ups & Treasure Chests Update
notes.notes: Player can get 2 power ups now. One is an automated holy ball with Angel skin, the other one is burning dash with Devil skin. Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Movement System & Visual Update
notes.notes: Movement system changes & Flying Slime death vfx, behavior changes & stealth duration & general config changes

notes.title: Movement & Models & Balance Changes
notes.notes: Egg hatching on spawns. Movement system changes, spawning system changes, general gameplay balance changes

notes.title: New Power : Stealth & Background Update
notes.notes:
You can go stealth now, eat greens to fill up your stealth bar and go stealth when you have no other options.
Background has been changed to make the environment more slimy, more underwaterish.

notes.title: Small Fixes & UI Changes
notes.notes: In game menu bug fixes & player dash button bug fix & scoreText on end game screen & death sfx volume fix

notes.title: Small Performance Update
notes.notes: Update for groundManager, fixed performnce issues when score is higjer than 100x

notes.title: Player Power Update
notes.notes: Player now has the ability to dissolve other slimes which are bigger. UI has been updated to display both Dash & Dissolve displays.
